newsitem.title: USA: Fire erupts in vacant New Jersey brewery.
newsitem.headline: Fire erupts in vacant New Jersey brewery.

text.p: A fire raged in a massive, vacant brewery in Patterson, New Jersey close to the center of town, police said Friday.
The general-alarm blaze started at around 2 a.m. EDT Friday morning and raged through the night despite calls for fire-fighting assistance from surrounding towns, police said.
Police said they were unsure who owned the old building and did not know if there had been any injuries. They also said they did not yet know the cause.
Neighboring buildings were not in danger, according to Lt. Craig Perrone.
